data_fields.name: stat_multiplier_per_variant
data_fields.donor_constant: layer op mul with a ratio, e.g. WalkSpeed x 0.7

best_idea: A content file is a layer over a named parent: it changes only the keys it writes, with mul, add and mul_round operations on the inherited number, so a variant of a stock unit is three or four lines of data and the stock stays the one source of truth.
decision_why: Take the layer-over-parent rule with op modifiers for legend and zone variants; change the number type to integer basis points with one rounding rule (the donor uses fixed-point for lockstep, which Frankendom does not need); reject the publish-to-players signed download for now (Dom only until beta).
acceptance: A server test loads a legend layer with parent legend_base and Health op=mul 1.2 and asserts Health equals the rounded product of the base value and 1.2; a looping or missing parent fails the load with the file name and no partial variant reaches a player.
